name: WCH CH340 / CH341 USB-serial adapter
summary: The cheap USB-serial chip on most Arduino clones, ESP8266/ESP32 boards and 3D printers.

linux.notes: The ch341 driver is built into Linux. On Ubuntu 22.04 and later the brltty braille service grabs this chip and the port vanishes; Plug Doctor detects and fixes that.

darwin.notes: Recent macOS versions include a driver. If no /dev/cu.* port appears, install WCH's driver and allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security.

win32.notes: Windows Update normally installs the driver. If not, WCH publishes CH341SER.
